subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Disturbing emotions begin to build into fear, and then ______.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**terror**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**disturbing**" suggests that the emotions being referred to are negative.
 
• "**Build into**" indicates a progression or escalation of these emotions.
 
• "**Fear**" is the final emotion mentioned, implying that it is the most intense or extreme of the sequence.
 
• Hence, "**Terror**" is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank because it fits this progression and conveys a sense of extreme fear or dread.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Complete sentence:** *Disturbing emotions begin to build into fear, and then terror__.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "**Boldness**," is the opposite of what is being described in the sentence and does not fit the progression from negative to extreme.
 
• Option 3: "**Server**," is unrelated to the context and does not make sense in the sentence.
 
• Option 4: "**Assurance**," is the opposite of what is being described in the sentence and does not fit the progression from negative to extreme.
